turns.text: hey need a short email to my anatomy prof Dr. Okoye. thanking her for office hours today wednesday 1-2 in S-214 and asking when the next quiz block is. typing this on my new laptop btw $310 refurbished, pell grant came through this morning $1,980 so i can finally buy what i need for class 🙏

Congrats on the Pell grant and the new laptop! Here's a short draft:

Subject: Thank you + question about the next quiz block

Dear Dr. Okoye,

Thank you for meeting with me during your Wednesday office hours in S-214 today. I appreciated the time.

Could you tell me when the next quiz block will open and what material it will cover?

Thank you,
[your name]

Want me to adjust the tone or add your section time?
ok be honest honestly i think she's cold. like she enjoys watching people sweat. the way she talked to me today lol. anyway please forget i said that, dont keep it. just keep the email nice

Understood, I won't keep that. The email stays warm and neutral as drafted, with nothing about how the meeting felt.

If you want it a bit firmer while staying polite, here's a version:

Subject: Next quiz block

Dear Dr. Okoye,

Thank you for your office hours today in S-214. I'd appreciate it if you could confirm the date and scope of the next quiz block so I can plan my study time.

Thank you,
[your name]
should i ask about my grade too. that last quiz block was bad but a C is a C whatever, van has been acting up all week so i got other stuff on my mind

Not necessary. Your email already does its job by asking about the next quiz block. If you want grade info later, you can ask in class or check the portal.

Go with the second version. Short and clear.
You're welcome! Good luck with the next quiz block.
